exposure: RBCX status (prophylactic RBCX vs. no RBCX)
outcome: sickle cell complications (vasoocclusive crisis, pulmonary complications, preeclampsia/eclampsia)
fetal complications (preterm birth, intrauterine growth restriction, perinatal mortality)
cohort: 37 pregnant women with sickle cell disease.
finding: Prophylactic RBCX during pregnancy was associated with a lower incidence of vasoocclusive crisis and maternal mortality in women with sickle cell disease.
who: Pregnant women with sickle cell disease and their fetuses
